notes.supports_cache_reset: v1.5.3 has no public free_cache. Rebuilding the Generator (fresh PageTable over the same Cache) is the only reset whose effect is observable: cached_tokens == 0 and the next identical prompt reports alloc_cached_pages == 0. Verified by the adapter conformance tests.
notes.supports_cuda_graphs: v1.5.3 has no CUDA-graph capture path.
notes.supports_kv_quantization: Available (CacheLayer_quant) but the official configuration runs the default fp16 cache.
notes.supports_prefix_cache: Automatic, page-granular (256-token pages) via a chained content-hash page table; best-effort under eviction.
notes.supports_static_batching: Real batched decode: all sequences are enqueued before any decode step and advance in lockstep, one token per iterate().

agent_like.description: repeated medium/long prefixes with small changing suffixes

interactive_burst.description: several SS/SM requests arriving closely together

long_job_interference.description: LL running while smaller interactive requests arrive

mixed_generation.description: short, medium and long outputs simultaneously
